Everyone who joins keeps their own vault and their own key. Only the items in this collection go through the shared folder; your other items stay private.

Share this collection with family or a team through a folder you all can reach, such as a shared OneDrive folder. Each person joins with the share password. That password protects the items in the folder, so give it only to people you invite.

Only the device that shared the collection can let people in or remove them. If that device is lost, the others keep their items and keep syncing, but nobody can change who is in. To start again, choose Forget share link for this collection on one of your other devices, then share it again into a new, empty folder.

Remove %1$s
%1$s knows the current share password, so removing them needs a new one. The others keep syncing without typing it; give it only to people you invite later.

%1$s will stop receiving changes to “%2$s”, and their copies of its items will move to their trash. Because %1$s knows the current share password, the collection gets the new share password you typed. The others keep syncing without typing it.

This shared collection needs a newer version of LocalGateKeys. Update the app to keep syncing it.
Upgrade share

Right now anyone who knows the share password can open the items in the shared folder. After the upgrade, only the people you let in can. Type the share password twice: the current one or a new one. Everyone in this collection needs this app version or later; older versions stop syncing it until they are updated.
Make this share safer
